spatial_support: global regular latitude-longitude grid; FARMWISE adapter requests a bounding-box subset and aggregates grid cells to requested S2 cells
temporal_support: hourly ERA5 data available from 1940 to present; FARMWISE dispatch currently uses data from 1950-01-01 to approximately 5 days before the current date and aggregates hourly observations to daily values
transformation: K to °C by subtracting 273.15; hourly instantaneous values are aggregated to daily mean
provider: Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S), implemented by ECMWF

provider: Deutscher Wetterdienst (DWD)

physical_meaning: depth to the groundwater table from the surface, reclassified to D index scores 1-10 using the class breaks of Aller et al. (1987)
spatial_support: raster compiled from national depth-to-water-table datasets, published in ETRS89-LAEA (EPSG:3035); FARMWISE reads a local copy named gewp7_peu1_d10km_4326.tif, takes pixel centres inside the bounding box and aggregates them to S2 cells
spatial_resolution: 10 km (INSPIRE reference grid)
temporal_support: static layer (created 2021-08-31); not a time series. FARMWISE repeats the value for every requested day
transformation: no unit conversion; nodata pixels are masked, the ordinal scores of pixels in each S2 cell are averaged with the configured within-source method (mean), so an output value can fall between two index classes
provider: Federal Institute for Geosciences and Natural Resources (BGR), distributed through EGDI
dataset: GeoERA HOVER WP7 - Pan-European Vulnerability to Pollution: D-Layer - Depth to water table (10km Resolution), layer gewp7_peu1_d
notes: Output column 'Depth to Watertable DRASTIC'. Published as 4-byte integer scores. Higher scores mean a shallower water table. The adapter declares no factor in API_PATH_RANGES because dispatch is disabled (not licensed for redistribution).

physical_meaning: hydraulic conductivity of the aquifer class, expressed as a DRASTIC C index score following the HOVER classification
spatial_support: hydraulic conductivity of IHME1500 Level 2 legend classes averaged from literature data, published in ETRS89-LAEA (EPSG:3035); FARMWISE reads a local copy named gewp7_peu7_4326.tif, takes pixel centres inside the bounding box and aggregates them to S2 cells
spatial_resolution: raster conversion of IHME1500 (1:1,500,000) Level 2 legend units; pixel size not stated in the EGDI metadata
temporal_support: static layer (created 2020-06-09); not a time series. FARMWISE repeats the value for every requested day
transformation: no unit conversion; nodata pixels are masked, the ordinal scores of pixels in each S2 cell are averaged with the configured within-source method (mean), so an output value can fall between two index classes
provider: Federal Institute for Geosciences and Natural Resources (BGR), distributed through EGDI
dataset: GeoERA HOVER WP7 - Pan-European Vulnerability to Pollution: C-Layer - Hydraulic conductivity, layer gewp7_peu7_c
notes: Output column 'Hydraulic Conductivity DRASTIC'. Published as 4-byte floating-point scores. The adapter declares no factor in API_PATH_RANGES because dispatch is disabled (not licensed for redistribution).
